item.title: Man Sues Shannon Hospital Over Objects Left in Body After Surgery
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — A Brown County man who suffered a workplace gunshot wound in 2022 has sued Shannon Medical Center, its management company, and three physicians, alleging medical negligence led to a prolonged infection after foreign material was left in his body following surgery. item.title: Garage Fire in North San Angelo Knocks Out Power in Neighborhood
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — A garage fire in north San Angelo on Friday afternoon caused at least five homes in the neighborhood to lose electricity.The fire began about 4 p.m. on Bowie Street near its intersection with 26th Street.Three fire engine trucks, a rescue truck and an ambulance responded to the scene, along with police vehicles to help block traffic. Learn More Here.

item.title: Central’s Reel Sets School Record, Reaches Finals at State Swimming Meet
item.description: AUSTIN, TX — San Angelo Central’s Elsa Reel qualified for the finals in both of her events Friday at the UIL Swimming & Diving Class 6A State Meet, setting a new school record in the process.Reel swam the 200-yard individual medley in a time of 2 minutes, 2.3 seconds to finish third in the prelims and set the school record. Learn More Here.

item.title: No. 1 Wall Overcomes Tolar to Claim Area Championship
item.description: BAIRD, TX — In the area-round playoff matchup against Tolar in Baird on Friday night, the No. 1-ranked Wall Lady Hawks found themselves trailing at halftime for one of the few times this season. Slow shooting early on, combined with a hot start from Tolar, put the Lady Hawks in an unfamiliar position. However, with adversity came the chance to overcome it, and the Lady Hawks delivered. Wall smothered Tolar in the final two quarters to claim the win, 58-42. Learn More Here.

item.title: Collision Involving Damage, Possession of Marijuana, and ICE Holds Lead Bookings
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — Corrections officers at the Tom Green County Jail report 8 bookings in the past 24 hours, led by arrests for collision involving damage to vehicle >=$200, possession of marijuana <2OZ, and miscellaneous ICE hold. There are currently 490 individuals booked in the Tom Green County Jail. Learn More Here.

item.title: No. 11 Angelo State Opens Series with a Run-Rule Win Over Oklahoma Christian
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — The No. 11 Angelo State baseball team returned home Friday night and defeated Oklahoma Christian 12-1 in a run-rule victory to open a four-game series at Foster Field at 1st Community Credit Union Stadium.The Rams improved to 8-3 overall and in Lone Star Conference play. item.title: San Angelo Central’s Reel Earns Top-5 Finishes at State Swimming Meet
item.description: AUSTIN, TX — San Angelo Central’s Elsa Reel finished her high school career with a pair of impressive top-five finishes Saturday at the UIL Swimming & Diving Class 6A State Meet at the Lee & Joe Jamail Texas Swimming Center at the University of Texas at Austin.Reel took fourth place in the 200-yard individual medley in a time of 2 minutes, 2.32 seconds.
